result: If I could change the world in one way, I would strive to eliminate global poverty. This change would have a profound impact on numerous aspects of society, including health, education, and overall quality of life. By addressing the root causes of poverty, such as lack of access to education, healthcare, and economic opportunities, we could create a more equitable and just world. This would not only improve the lives of millions of people but also contribute to global stability and peace.
